# Design

Sync: a new syncgate module owns a single-writer index gate around cg_index. The gate takes a non-blocking flock on .codegraph/index.lock; a loser touches .codegraph/index.dirty and returns coalesced; the winner drains the dirty marker in bounded passes before releasing. A freshness window keyed by meta.last_index_at lets hooks, MCP, and spec commands skip the walk. Machine-wide slots under /tmp/codify-<uid> cap parse threads across projects, and hook syncs run at low priority. Post-scan resolution is scoped to changed file ids and touched symbol names through temp tables; --full keeps the global pass. Hooks collapse to one cg hook post-edit process. The extension coalesces refreshes and ignores its own graph.db writes. Hierarchy: workflow.kvx gains a [hierarchy] section and per-role [role.*] sections; identity gains role and parent; a new fleet module wraps git worktree, merge, gate, gh pr, and checkpoint flows over popen; the orchestrator grows a two-level slot tree. Unified graph: schema v15 adds branches, files.branch_id, memories.branch, and a content table keyed by hash; root discovery resolves worktrees to the git common dir; queries default to the current branch. Jev: a jev module builds canonical requests, runs curl, parses answers, retries, and logs cost; memory classify, failure triage, and guard ranking are its first consumers; the local_only principle becomes local_first. Extension: task tree, memory browser, fleet view, and agent chat are rebuilt on the same zero-dependency, CSP-strict webview base.
